summary.text: Jamie Barton is the Republican incumbent, in office since December 1, 2022, seeking re-election to the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 124, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as executive.

paragraphs.text: Jamie Barton graduated from Blue Mountain High School in 1982 and earned a B.S. in business administration from Alvernia University in 2007.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as including work as an energy executive.

Barton assumed office on December 1, 2022, and his 2023-2024 committee assignments, as listed by Ballotpedia, were Urban Affairs & Housing, State Government (subcommittee chair on Government Information Technology and Communication), and Tourism & Recreational Development (secretary).
